capabilities: sync note names, tags, and links to an ideamap account
authenticate with an ideamap API token
open notes in Obsidian from ideamap's vault graph
confirm inbound sync requests via the obsidian://ideamap-sync URI
disambiguation: Not cross-device vault synchronization; only note metadata is uploaded to ideamap, and note contents stay on the device.
extras: README warns that note names, folder names, and tags alone can be sensitive; the API token is stored in the plugin's data.json and should be excluded from public backups. Accounts are free, and each sync fully replaces the previous import.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export a vault's structure (titles, tags, link graph) to the ideamap platform for viewing and linking back into the vault.

relations.evidence: Import your vault's note names, tags, and links into your ideamap account.

summary: Syncs note names, tags, and links from a vault into the user's ideamap account, without uploading note contents.
